honesty_boundary: No component labeled 'clinically validated' (regulatory term of art). Each component carries its strongest HONEST earned tier from real outcome-linked cohorts. 'COHORT_VALIDATED_RUO' requires EPV>=10 AND CI excluding None in >=1 endpoint. 'COHORT_TESTED_NULL' = tested on a real cohort, no significant association (honest, evidence-backed). 'BORDERLINE_RUO' = 5<=exposed<10 (underpowered). 'INSUFFICIENT_EVENTS' = <5 exposed. 'DISCOVERY_ONLY' (5.3 models) = OOF AUC 95% CI spans 0.5.

cohorts_v2.pull_method: Rscript export to gene-symbol CSV + pData; serous-filtered at analysis time
cohorts_v2.independence_rule: TCGA_eset + TCGA.RNASeqV2_eset EXCLUDED from replication of any gene fit on TCGA-OV; GSE63885 not in this set so all curatedOV cohorts independent for MFAP4.
cohorts_v2.anti_fabrication: Resistance label = recurrence<183d (event & time both present); never imputed. Serous filter on histological_type. Excluded cohorts logged.

logit_resistance_probability_expr.design: Pooled leave-one-cohort-out nested CV; EXPRESSION features (z-scored per cohort); L2 logistic, class-balanced.
logit_resistance_probability_expr.feature_channel_note: Features are EXPRESSION z-scores of resistance-candidate genes, NOT somatic-mutation flags. This is a distinct feature space from the report's mutation-based genomic logit. Reported as an expression-based resistance classifier.
logit_resistance_probability_expr.honesty_statement: Bootstrap OOF-AUC CI stably excludes 0.5 (100% of seeds), meeting the pre-specified CI rule; however the within-cohort permutation test p=0.055 does NOT confirm at alpha=0.05. Therefore this is labeled CALIBRATED_RUO_BORDERLINE, NOT robustly calibrated. Event-limited (52 events, raw EPV 3.7). Brier 0.225 indicates modest calibration. NOT 'clinically validated'.
logit_resistance_probability_expr.relation_to_v1_model_53: v1 model_53 tested a MUTATION-based genomic logit (DISCOVERY_ONLY, OOF AUC 0.489). This v2 model is a distinct EXPRESSION-based classifier on 518 pooled samples/52 events. They are complementary, not the same model. v1 model_53 verdict retained above.

model_53_v3.honesty: Track A features derived on TCGA and LOCKED; evaluated only on independent held-out cohorts. Track B uses independent cohorts only. No 'clinically validated' claim.
model_53_v3.note: Track A: multivariable Cox risk score derived on TCGA (locked coefs + tertile cutoffs), evaluated ONLY on independent held-out cohorts. Track B: 5-feature parsimonious classifier (EPV 10.4, permutation p=0.005) clears CALIBRATED bar that the v2 14-feature model failed (p=0.055). Neither is clinically validated; both RUO.

ctdna_outcome.decision_scope: PROGNOSTIC ONLY. WIRED_PROGNOSTIC_ONLY_V1: structurally excluded from resistance probability & drug routing. TF/PF cutoffs exploratory, NOT locked clinical thresholds. NOT 'clinically validated'.

plco_outcome_context.scope: SCREENING cohort. CA-125 kinetics early-signal vs disease aggressiveness (stage) and post-diagnosis survival in incident cases. OUTCOME CONTEXT for a screening biomarker. NOT a treatment-resistance predictor; NEVER 'clinically validated'.

analysis_1_stage.interpretation: AUROC/CI and Spearman quantify whether faster pre-dx CA-125 kinetics associate with later stage at diagnosis.

analysis_2_survival_after_dx.interpretation: Cox HR per SD of pre-dx CA-125 log-slope for post-diagnosis ovarian-cancer death; KM tertile separation by log-rank.

plco_outcome_context.conclusion: Pre-diagnosis CA-125 kinetics detect INCIDENT ovarian cancer (screening AUROC 0.652) but do NOT associate with stage-at-diagnosis (AUROC 0.531, CI incl. 0.5) or post-diagnosis survival (HR/SD 1.06, p=0.42). This is the tested, quantitative reason PLCO cannot be repurposed as a treatment-resistance predictor. Screening-only.

analytical_validation.disclaimer: IN-SILICO analytical validation (precision/reproducibility/robustness analogs). NOT wet-lab analytical validation (LoD/LoQ/precision) under a quality system. RUO.

model53_reference.note: 5.3 analytical stability inherits Track B LOCO-CV bootstrap CI already computed in W2.

v3_changelog.summary: v3 evidence-upgrade: survival (OS) outcome validation of markers (W1), 5.3 survival risk score + parsimonious classifier (W2), ctDNA outcome replication (W3), PLCO deeper outcome-context analyses (W4b), in-silico analytical validation (W5). All v2 keys retained.
v3_changelog.honesty_boundary: Ceiling = EXTERNALLY_VALIDATED_RUO (RUO). NO component labeled 'clinically validated'. Prospective + analytical (wet-lab, QMS) validation NOT done.
